text: How I go from 2100 to 1900 every time I get on Every single time I get on this game I start out a usually 2000, sometimes 2100. And when I start playing, I go on a losing streak and drop all the way down to 1900. Sometimes 1880. What have I noticed? The gap between 1900 and 2100 is based on 2 things: reading your opponents movement patterns (not attack patterns). punishing their movement patterns. From 1850-1950 players are pretty good at just punishing people when they miss. And people mostly miss because players are annoyingly passive, running away. They also get players to miss by baiting them. And the bait is 90% of the time just running, waiting at the edge of the stage, and waiting for their opponent to approach and try to attack, then countering or attack before they even get to them. How to reach 2000? read/feel opponents tempo/rhythm and move with it. Keep interrupting their rhythm punishing their movement mistakes and patterns. Players get careless and land places where it’s easy to hit them. Also jump towards players where it’s easy to hit them. They also repeatedly make the same movements (not attacks, movements) realize your own rhythm/tempo and change it constantly through the match. Don’t stay passive, don’t stay aggressive. Change yourself as the game goes on and realize what works against that opponent. realize all your combos fall short when your opponent can read your movement, attack patterns and tempo.
